TEST ORDER, SET BY THE USER 2026-07-31: (1) INSTALL ON THIS WINDOWS DEV PC FIRST — a full engine install after the bump, to shake out whatever ComfyUI 0.29 breaks, before any build is cut. (2) THEN THE RENTED MAC — rebuild in CI and re-run the fresh install/launch/generate test there. (3) THEN LINUX, 'just to see how far it takes us' — expressly a stretch, not a gate: that ThinkPad cannot boot ComfyUI at all (MPI-415, kornia_rs SIGILL on a 2011 CPU with no avx2/fma), so it can only ever prove the install half, never a generation.

DEFECT A (the publish blocker) — THE UV ENGINE INSTALLS AN UNPINNED COMFYUI AND THEN STAMPS IT WITH THE PINNED VERSION. Measured on the Mac: engine/.mpi_engine_version reads 0.28.0 while engine/ComfyUI_macos/comfyui_version.py reads 0.29.0. `comfy install` args at routes/engine.js:405-407 pass NO version flag, so comfy-cli takes whatever is current on master; routes/engine.js:538-544 then writes config.engine.version (the pin) regardless. The drift is SELF-CONCEALING: /engine/version-check (routes/engine.js:613-620) compares that stamp to COMFY_VERSION, both read 0.28.0, so it matches and no repair is ever offered. Consequence seen live at boot: our pinned ComfyUI-LTXVideo commit cannot import against 0.29.0 — `cannot import name 'interleaved_freqs_cis' from 'comfy.ldm.lightricks.model'` (verified on the box: core 0.29.0 does NOT define it; ComfyUI-LTXVideo/embeddings_connector.py:13 imports it, used at :258). LTX VIDEO IS DEAD ON EVERY LOCAL UV ENGINE — macOS AND Linux. Windows is unaffected because its prebuilt-archive path is genuinely pinned. TIME-ACTIVATED: while 0.28.0 was current the unpinned install happened to produce the right thing; it broke the day 0.29.0 shipped.

DEFECT B — TAESD PREVIEWS ENABLED, DECODER NEVER SHIPPED. We set `--preview-method taesd` (routes/comfy.js:390) and Comfy.Execution.PreviewMethod / Comfy.PreviewMethod (routes/engine.js:527-528), but no taesd/vae_approx entry exists anywhere in js/data/modelConstants/ and models/vae_approx/ does not exist on disk. Every generation logs `Warning: TAESD previews enabled, but could not find models/vae_approx/taesdxl_decoder` and there is NO live preview image during sampling. Cause is platform-independent. Either ship the decoder as a universal dep or stop enabling taesd.

FIX 1 — PIN THE INSTALLER. Pass an explicit version to `comfy install`. comfy-cli supports it: `--version <str>` and `--commit <str>`, CONFIRMED from comfy-cli's own --help on the Mac. Never install an unpinned ComfyUI again (the user's words: 'We can never install a different comfyui version because it's most likely gonna break stuff that we can't fix').

FIX 2 — STAMP THE TRUTH, NOT THE HOPE. After install, read <engine>/<COMFY_DIR>/comfyui_version.py and stamp THAT into .mpi_engine_version. Stamping the pin blindly is what made this invisible; version-check currently compares a lie to a lie.

FIX 3 — BUMP CORE 0.28.0 -> 0.29.2. Latest release is v0.29.2 (the Mac's unpinned install landed 0.29.0, NOT latest — more evidence unpinned is unpredictable). Edit dev_configs/node_lock.json comfyui.core.tag + .commit AND dev_configs/system_dependencies.json engine.version (currently 0.28.0). WARNING: node_lock.json is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH consumed by BOTH the app and the RunPod Pod image build (its own _doc says so).

FIX 4 — BUMP THE FRONTEND PINS in node_lock.json. Ours read comfyui-frontend-package 1.45.21 and comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.9. The 0.29 changelog moves the frontend package to 1.47.10 (#15045) and templates to 0.11.19 (#15123). Verify against the actual 0.29.2 tag, do not trust the changelog alone.

FIX 5 — BUMP ComfyUI-LTXVideo. Current pin is commit 4f45fd6c222eb06eb3e46605da62e7c889e4be5c. The core change that broke it is 'Use comfy kitchen rope functions in ltx models' (#15056). Find the Lightricks commit that adapts to it. Related 0.29 LTX changes to sanity-check: #15073 (IC-lora detection), #15106 (float fps for LTXVEmptyLatentAudio).

FIX 6 — SWEEP EVERY OTHER PINNED NODE FOR 0.29 COMPATIBILITY, not just LTX. 15 universal nodes in node_lock.json. Do this on the user's Windows bench at G:\ComfyUi using the mpi-bump-local-comfy skill — the user explicitly asked for it to be verified working on their computer before a build is cut. Also worth checking: 0.29 added krea 2 reference-image support for ostris and identity-edit ref LoRAs (#14843), which touches our Krea2 injection.
FIX 7 — THE WINDOWS PREBUILT-ARCHIVE PATH also keys off the pinned version and needs its ComfyUI_windows_portable URL + hash updated to the 0.29.2 assets (visible on the GitHub release page).

FIX 8 — DECIDE THE POD/REMOTE HALF. node_lock.json ALSO drives the Pod image build (c:\AI\Mpi\mpi-ci\cubric-vision-pod, skill build-pod-image). Memory records the Pod at ComfyUI 0.26/0.27. Bumping core to 0.29.2 diverges local from remote unless the Pod image is rebuilt. THE ROOT-CAUSE RULE's dual-engine clause applies — do not fix only the local twin. Raise this with the user before assuming a Pod rebuild is in scope.

THEN: rebuild the artifacts in CI, and RE-RUN THE MAC INSTALL TEST on this same rented box (fresh extract, fresh engine). The user's instruction: 'I don't wanna touch another Mac anytime soon' — so do as much Apple-hardware-only work as fits in the window.
